environmental.operating-temperature: 5 to 40 C normal; -5 to 55 C short-term (SR1 Table 31)

performance.capacity: 3.0 Tb/s half-duplex; 750 Gb/s full-duplex per MDA slot (1.5 Tb/s variants)

power.power-input-dc: -48 VDC, 40/30 A per source (-40 to -72 VDC), dual feed A and B

configs.description: The DC chassis with its fixed terminal block and four fan trays, as SR1 Figure 5 draws the DC rear.
configs.name: base

gaps.note: No photograph of an SR-1 is staged, so every colour is estimated and the finish of the intake, the label lens and the fan guards is unconfirmed.

gaps.wanted: the buried marks moved clear of the components that paint over them

a `power-draw-max-w` on each module this chassis accepts, from the vendor's own per-card table - Cisco publishes one per ambient, most vendors publish none, and until they land a module total is a floor

`attrs.platform.cpu`, `attrs.platform.memory`; one of `operating-temp`, `operating-temp-f2b`, `operating-temp-b2f` in `attrs.environmental` (profile `networking` - see spec/schemas/profiles.yaml) - unlocks the About panel, and comparison against other devices
`physical-context` on 6 bays (front 2, rear 4) - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays

airflow.note: SR1 p75-76: front intake through the honeycomb vent, rear exhaust through the four fan trays; the PSU shelf has its own front-to-rear stream through each supply's fan.

chassis.note: SR1 Tables 29/30 p89: 3.5 x 19.0 x 24.6 in (8.9 x 48.3 x 62.5 cm), H x W x D, and note 2: "Width includes the integrated flanges for rack mounting". The body between the fold lines is 440.0 (SR1 Figure 4 at 1200 dpi: body 2222-7966 px, ears 1945-8646, 13.055 px/mm), so the flanges are about 21 mm a side and are not drawn. Height 88.9 (2RU); depth 624.8 (24.6 in, excluding protrusions: note 3). Weight unpopulated: 33.0 lb (15.0 kg), Table 29.

colour.note: No photograph is staged. A charcoal chassis with a light honeycomb intake is taken from the family's dark faceplates and the vendor figures' tints, not observed.

fan-bays.note: SR1 Figure 5 p48 (both variants alike): the four tray outlines run 93.9-178.1, 178.8-262.9, 263.5-347.6 and 348.2-432.7 across and 0.0-85.8 down, a pitch of 84.8; the stated 82.8 x 83.1 bays are centred on them at x 94.6 / 179.4 / 264.2 / 349.1, y 1.4. FAN 1-4 run left to right as seen from behind and are printed on the top of the chassis (Table 6 key 8; SR1 p161 "numbered 1 to 4 from left to right on the top of the chassis").

front-controls.note: SR1 Table 7 pp51-52: Console is an RJ45 UART port; Mgmt, 1588/SyncE and OES1 are 10/100 Mb/s Ethernet (OES1 is the GMPLS-UNI IP control channel, OES2 is reserved for future use); ACO/LT is the alarm cut-off / lamp test and Bluetooth pairing button; Alarm is a DB9; BITS is an RJ45 clock input; 1PPS is an SMB 50 ohm output; CF2 is a compact flash drive and CF3 one behind a hinged cover; DTE/DCE is the console mode switch. The Bluetooth lens (key 8) covers the internal transceiver.

front-layout.note: SR1 Figure 4 p47, positions in mm from the body top-left: chassis label (lens) 15.0-41.8 x 9.6-17.2 with "7750 SR-1" / "Service Router" under it; Stat/Pwr lamps (66.4, 8.0/15.1); CF 1-3 at x 71.9, y 8.0/11.6/15.1; OT and BT at x 77.1; Crit/Maj/Min at x 82.4 (lamps drawn 2.9 across); DTE/DCE slide switch 87.4-91.2 x 9.5-17.4; Console RJ45 centre (102.9, 11.3); Bluetooth lens 114.8-133.5 x 7.2-18.5; a 1 x 4 RJ45 shell 136.0-195.4 x 3.8-18.3 holding Mgmt, 1588/SyncE, OES1, OES2 on a 13.97 pitch (jack edges measured 138.5 / 152.3 / 166.3 / 180.2); ACO/LT button centre (200.2, 11.8); Alarm DB9 shell 209.6-230.4 with standoffs at 207.5 / 232.6 (30.9 over both, common/db9-receptacle@1 is 30.8); BITS RJ45 centre (246.5, 11.35); 1PPS SMB centre (260.5, 11.9); CF2 slot 267.2-319.7 x 8.7-19.0; the CF3 hinged cover 319.7-371.9 x 6.1-27.7 with its thumbscrew at (348.8, 21.8); ESD warning triangle (376.8, 22.9); legends baseline about 21.0. Intake: a band 63.8-418.2 x 27.7-43.6, a block 381.4-432.5 x 6.1-43.6 and a strip 418.2-432.6 x 43.6-82.2. ESD jack centre (13.5, 77.0). MDA slot 1 printed "1" at (33.2, 81.8), slot 2 "2" at (405.6, 81.5).

front-leds.note: SR1 Table 72 pp206-207 (Stat green / green slow blink / amber; Pwr blue; CF 1-3 green, amber fast blink, amber; BT green blink / green / amber; OT, Crit, Maj red; Min amber) and Table 73 pp208-209 (Mgmt, 1588/SyncE and OES1 link: green 100 Mb/s full-duplex, green blinking half-duplex, amber 10 Mb/s, amber blinking; activity green blinking, amber blinking on errors; OES2 for future use; BITS amber = configured and no clock, green = clock). Which of a jack's two windows is link and which is activity is not stated; led-a is taken as link. CF1 is the internal flash, "currently not used", but its lamp is fitted. The figure numbers the CF lamps 1-3 INSIDE the lamp circles; those numerals sit under the lamp parts and are not drawn. The lamps are drawn 2.9 mm across and are placed as common/led-dot@1 (2 mm), the part that fits the 3.5 mm CF pitch. The 1588/SyncE and BITS jacks are lamped parts although L76 files timing jacks as bare: Table 73 gives both lamps (SyncE link and activity, BITS a clock LED) and Figures 4 and 6 draw two windows on each, so the hardware wins over the rule's role heuristic.

ground.note: SR1 p72: a two-stud safety ground left of the PSU area / terminal block, for the Panduit LCD6-10AH-L two-hole 45-degree lug in the accessory kit. It is drawn as two hex nuts in panel decor on a plate, with common/ground-symbol@1 for the printed earth mark: common/ carries no bare earthing stud and the studs in the library belong to other makers, so no part is borrowed for it.

mda-slots.note: SR1 Figure 4 and p53 ("two slots... at the bottom"): both slots 193.0 x 35.4, the MDA envelope of the wave-1 conventions, at x 26.8 and 220.3, y 48.4 (the drawn plate outlines run 25.7-414.0 over their 1.5 mm strokes). Cards are HORIZONTAL and no bay rotates (SR1 Figure 55 p166; XP Figure 30). The MDA-e-XP family seats in any SR-1; the MDA2-e-XP family only in the 1.5 Tb/s revisions (3HE12298xxRD and higher, 3HE12299xxRB and higher, SR1 p46), which accepts cannot express. Figure 4 draws slot 1 with an ME6-100GB-QSFP28 and slot 2 with the impedance panel 3HE10312AA, of which one ships with each chassis (SR1 p84). The printed slot numbers "1" and "2" lie inside the bay boxes, in the notched lower corners every MDA plate leaves open (wings 27 mm tall, conventions section 2), which is where Figure 4 shows them readable with a card fitted; L21 reads the bay as a full rectangle.

panel-scale.note: Gate 1. SR1 Figure 4 (front) at 1200 dpi: the body measures 5744 x 1166 px over its outer strokes, 13.055 px/mm across and 13.12 down, 0.5 percent apart, so the figure is orthographic. Figure 5 (rear, both variants) measures 5739 x 1145 px: 13.04 across, 12.88 down, 1.2 percent apart; positions on the rear are taken at those per-axis scales. Every position below was read on a 1 mm grid laid over those renders and is good to about 0.3 mm.

power.note: SR1 Table 34 p92: the four fan trays and the PSUs combined draw 34 W idle, 410 W at 25C (50% line rate), 575 W at 40C and 830 W at 55C (100% line rate), EXCLUDING the MDA-e-XP / MDA2-e-XP cards and optics; PSUs run at 90% efficiency. The 830 W is carried as the vendor's system figure with that scope; the cards carry their own figures (Table 35) and optics are extra. Rated input -48 VDC, 40/30 A per source, -40 to -72 VDC (Table 31).

rear-layout.note: SR1 Figure 5 p48, DC rear, seen from behind. The terminal block (nokia/sr-1-dc-terminal- block@1) fills the recess from (12.5, 1.0) to (88.0, 85.6), the area the AC chassis gives its PSU slots. Two-stud safety ground (hex nuts about 7.5 across) at (7.6, 29.0) and (7.6, 45.0) on a plate 3.0-12.5 x 21.9-58.1, earth symbol at (7.4, 55.1). The AC figure reads the studs at x 6.8; the two are the same metal, and each view keeps its own reading.

sides.note: SR1 Figures 36 and 38 (isometric) draw the right side plain apart from screw heads and the optional rear rack bracket; Figure 34 shows no side features. No figure draws the left side or the bottom square-on.

sources.note: Written first. (1) SR1 = 7750 SR-1 Chassis Installation Guide 25.10, 3HE22130AAAATQZZA01: Figure 4 p47 (front), Figure 5 p48 (rear, AC and DC variants), Figure 6 pp50-52 and Table 7 (front LEDs, ports and controls), Tables 4, 29-36 (variants, dimensions, power), chapter 10 pp206-211 (LEDs), Figure 34 p106 (top view). Every figure used is VECTOR: pdfimages -list finds no raster on pp47-48, 106, and so pdftocairo at 1200 dpi is exact. (2) the part contracts of every seated module. No photograph of an SR-1 is staged; PUBLIC-SOURCES lists NK/2018-11/7750_SR-1_f.jpg and DS 164728, neither fetched.

top.note: SR1 Figure 34 p106 (clearance, view from top) prints FAN 4, FAN 3, FAN 2, FAN 1 along the rear edge, upside down as read from the front, FAN 1 at the right. The figure is a schematic (its body aspect is 0.653 against 0.704), so the legends are placed over the fan bays they name rather than where that drawing puts them; y = 0 is the REAR edge of the top view (the viewer draws the front at the image bottom). Nothing else is drawn on the top in any figure; the isometric Figures 36 and 38 show only screw heads along the edges, which are not placed.
